 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Angel Reese and the Atlanta Dream are battling Veronica Burton and Co. in Game 6 of the 2026 WNBA Finals, and the matchup has been as intense as expected. While the Dream have dominated the first half, leading 46-26 at halftime on Thursday, a moment between Naz Hillmon and Burton drew attention.
 A moment in the first quarter riled up Golden State Valkyries fans when the right foot of Hillmon, a Dream power forward, struck the upper body of Burton, a Valkyries guard.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement On the play, Burton fell to the floor under the basket after missing a layup. Hillmon, who was trailing the play and closing in on Burton as she shot, grabbed the rebound, but as she pivoted to pass the ball the other way without looking down, her foot caught Burton, who started to get up and raised her left arm.
 A user shared the clip on X:
 Fans reacted to the post, as one wrote:
 "Hillmon just kicked Burton while she was on the ground I've never seen a play that dirty before get completely ignored by everyone"
 Meanwhile, some other fans believed it was not intentional.
 Fans pointed out multiple other moments where Dream players seemingly got away with fouls on the Valkyries. However, the series has been physically intense for both teams, and officiating, as is usual in the heated gamesmanship of a playoff series, has been questioned. Angel Reese also complained about referees at the press conference after Game 5.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Allisha Gray and Rhyne Howard have taken up the scoring duties, with 10 and 11 points, respectively. Angel Reese hasn't looked comfortable in Game 6 either, shooting 2-for-8.
 Angel Reese doesn't let the intensity down against Veronica Burton and Co.
 Angel Reese has been the most aggressive player on the Dream this postseason. Although her production has dipped in the last couple of games, she was full of fire in Game 6. After getting her first bucket in the game, she let it all out on the opponent's bench.
 If the Dream manage to force Game 7, the title-deciding game will be on Saturday night in San Francisco.
